intro.title: Frequently Asked Questions
intro.description: Straight answers about how we work. If yours is not here, ask us directly.

items.q: What kinds of projects do you take on?
items.a: Custom software and web applications, SaaS products, AI and LLM integrations, data pipelines, system integrations, process automation, cloud and DevOps work, UI/UX design, QA, and IoT or industrial software. If you are unsure whether something fits, a short discovery call will tell us both.

With a discovery conversation. We learn about your goals, constraints, and existing systems, then follow up with a proposed scope, approach, and timeline. Nothing is built until scope and milestones are agreed.

It depends on the engagement model. Defined projects are scoped against agreed milestones, while dedicated teams and long-term partnerships are typically agreed on a time and capacity basis. We share a clear estimate before work begins.

items.q: Who owns the code and the data?
items.a: You do. Source code, designs, and data created for your project belong to you, and we hand everything over with documentation so you are never locked in.

items.q: How do you work across time zones?
items.a: We are remote-first and based in Finland (UTC+2) on a 40-hour standard week. We agree overlap windows with each client, share written updates, and demo progress regularly so you always know where things stand.

items.q: How do you handle security and confidentiality?
items.a: We use role-based access, encrypted communication, and proper secrets management, and we are happy to sign an NDA before discussing your project. Security is considered in architecture and testing from the start.

items.q: Do you offer support after launch?
items.a: Yes. Maintenance and improvement is the seventh phase of our lifecycle: bug fixes, security updates, performance tuning, and continued feature development under a support or partnership agreement.

items.q: Can you work with our existing team or codebase?
items.a: Absolutely. Our dedicated team model is designed to embed with your engineers, tools, and rituals. We also take on modernization work for existing applications.
